item.title: Family auto group begins work on Clearwater motorcycle showroom
item.description: The Dimmitt Automotive Group has begun construction on a new facility — and it's not a car dealership.The fourth-generation Clearwater company is building a new showroom and service center for Cycle Springs Powersports, which sells personal watercraft, motorcycles, ATVs and side-by-sides.Dimmitt bought Cycle Springs in 2023.The work will include the demolition of the existing facilities on the same U.S. Highway 19 property. item.title: Dalí Museum plans $65M expansion
item.description: The Dalí Museum in downtown St. Petersburg announced plans on Wednesday for a $65 million expansion that will more than double its size by 2028. The museum itself is already a surrealist sanctuary showcasing more than 2,400 of the late artist Salvador Dalí’s works from every period and medium of the artist’s life. item.title: Cement supplier expanding at Port Tampa Bay, bringing 25 jobs
item.description: A national, Houston-based cement and buildings material supplier has embarked on a major expansion of its operations at Port Tampa Bay and hopes to hire 25 local employees by April. SESCO Cement announced Thursday that it has completed installation of a large-scale, custom ship unloader at its berth in the Port Redwing site in Gibsonton. item.title: Prominent Midwest auto dealer's Naples condo hits market for $15M
item.description: A beachfront condo in Naples, owned by a longtime prominent auto dealer from the Midwest who died of leukemia last month, has been listed for sale for just under $15 million. The condo is The Vanderbilt at Vanderbilt Beach, 9235 Gulf Shore Drive, Unit TL-2. The listing price is $14.99 million. The listing brokers, according to a statement, are Leah Ritchey and Amy Becker of Premier Sotheby’s International Realty’s Vanderbilt office. item.title: AdventHealth nearing completion of Pasco medical office building
item.description: AdventHealth is one step closer toward opening new medical offices on its Zephyrhills campus in Pasco County, according to a release. Officials signed the final construction beam for the 35,000-square-foot medical office building on Wednesday during a “topping out” ceremony held roughly six months after the project broke ground in late August. item.title: Nordstrom Rack sets Sarasota store opening date
item.description: An off-price retailer will open in the Sarasota Pavilion in mid-March. Nordstrom Rack has set its opening date for Thursday, March 19, at the shopping plaza at the corner of Stickney Point Road and US 41.The store will occupy 27,000 square feet in a spot that used to house Bed, Bath & Beyond. Nordstrom first announced its plans to locate there in 2024.
